groups.name: Soul
groups.profile: Dumped 25 US-heavy company profiles (clinics, law firms, manufacturers) within 90 seconds (20:35–20:36 UTC), each with employee and revenue figures but no data inventory.
groups.countries: Spain (2), Argentina, Australia, Panama, United States, not disclosed (19)

groups.name: MedusaLocker
groups.profile: Ransomware operation active since 2019, historically entering via exposed RDP and phishing (Ransomware.live's group card wrongly describes a DDoS bot of the same name). Tracked since 2022-11-15. A 17-record burst in ten minutes (22:17–22:27 UTC), Ransomware.live-only: several names do not match their descriptions, two are bare email-count entries, four are random-looking strings (excluded as masked) and one is a webmail domain (excluded as non-victim).
groups.countries: Brazil, Canada, China, India, Morocco, South Africa, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States, not disclosed (3)
groups.sectors: Manufacturing (3), Not disclosed (3), Professional Services (2), Education, Retail & E-Commerce, Technology, Transportation

groups.name: Brain Cipher
groups.profile: Emerged July 2024 using a leaked LockBit Black build (Windows and Linux); suspected abuse of CVE-2023-28252; ransom demands reported from $150K to $1M in Monero. Eleven bare domain listings in two waves today, none with a description.
groups.countries: United States (6), Canada (2), Germany, not disclosed (2)
groups.sectors: Financial Services (3), Healthcare (2), Not disclosed (2), Professional Services (2), Agriculture and Food Production, Technology

groups.name: SafePay
groups.profile: Emerged September 2024; disavows the RaaS model and runs operations in-house; 300+ claimed victims by mid-2025. Eight postings in six minutes, five of them German organisations incl. a psychiatric hospital and a youth-welfare centre.
groups.countries: Germany (4), Australia, Belgium, Spain, United States
groups.sectors: Other (2), Education, Healthcare, Hospitality, Manufacturing, Not disclosed, Professional Services

groups.name: Play
groups.profile: Also PlayCrypt. Active since June 2022; double extortion, initial access via valid accounts, phishing and exposed services; tooling incl. Mimikatz, Nanodump and EDR-killer drivers. Five name-plus-country postings in four minutes.

groups.name: Aoqin
groups.profile: New leak site, first tracked by Ransomware.live on 2026-11-04. Four postings in two minutes (00:52–00:54 UTC), each with a screenshot, a "Not paid" status and a publication date of 10–11 November. Ransomware.live-only so far.
groups.sectors: Energy & Utilities, Manufacturing, Professional Services, Technology

groups.name: Dark Project
groups.profile: Leak operation tracked since 2026-08-05; double extortion. Today's three US postings state volumes (500+ GB, 70+ GB) and include a nonprofit food bank.

groups.name: Akira
groups.profile: Active since March 2023, widely linked to former Conti members; double extortion with Windows and ESXi lockers; known for abusing VPN appliances without MFA. Both posts promise uploads (538 GB, 27 GB).

groups.name: PEAR
groups.profile: Pure Extraction And Ransom (PEAR), tracked since 2025-08-05; a data-theft-and-extortion team that says it works privately with no affiliates. Both postings RansomLook-only.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS that emerged in May 2023; phishing and Cobalt Strike for intrusion; auctions stolen data. Both postings are unusually detailed sale lots, incl. a US city's police and 911 data (~7.8 TB).

groups.name: BYOD
groups.profile: Leak site tracked since 2026-10-05; no published tactics profile.

groups.name: Destello
groups.profile: Brand-new leak site: Ransomware.live added it on 2026-11-05, after this window, so it is RansomLook-only today. Its posting format shows a "verified access" label, a staged-percentage counter and a deadline.

groups.name: Doommageddon
groups.profile: Leak site tracked since 2026-07-06; direct and double extortion. Posts carry status, data size and file count.

groups.name: Global Secret Group
groups.profile: Also GSG. Tracked since 2026-07-26; posts a structured card with revenue, headcount and data volume.

groups.name: Interlock
groups.profile: First observed September 2024; double extortion against healthcare, government, education and technology in North America and Europe; fake browser-update / ClickFix lures; tooling incl. AZCopy and BYOVD drivers.

groups.name: LockBit 5.0
groups.profile: LockBit 5.0 ("ChuongDong"), the brand's September 2025 relaunch after the February 2024 takedown; cross-platform Windows, Linux and ESXi payloads, affiliate RaaS model.

groups.name: RansomHouse
groups.profile: Double-extortion operation active since late 2021 ("Jolly Scorpius"); 120+ organisations claimed. Today's entry is a bare title.
